Team.title: Team
Team.description: User created Aniimo team build consisting of up to 4 Aniimo with held items and awakening point investments.

tag.description: Team category tag (e.g. DPS, Campaign, Egg Heist, PvE, PvP, 1v1)

memberIds.description: Array of up to 4 Aniimo IDs in the team

membersJson.description: Serialized configuration of team members (items, awakenings, skill order)

isPublic.description: Whether this team is shared publicly for others to search and rate

DiscussionPost.title: DiscussionPost
DiscussionPost.description: Community discussion board post for discussing ideas, builds, and strategies on specific Aniimo.

PostComment.title: PostComment
PostComment.description: User comment on a discussion post.

LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Speedrun or boss clear submission with video proof link and community legit verification votes.

aniimoIds.description: Array of Aniimo IDs used in clear

videoUrl.description: Video proof URL (YouTube, Twitch, Streamable, etc.)

notLegitVotes.description: Count of Not Legit community votes

isVerified.description: Computed verification status based on votes

SubmissionVote.title: SubmissionVote
SubmissionVote.description: User legit/not legit verification vote on a leaderboard entry.

isLegit.description: True if vote is Legit, False if Not Legit

reason.description: Optional reason note for the vote

LivePatchNote.title: LivePatchNote
LivePatchNote.description: Live Aniimo patch notes and balance updates that dynamically reconfigure skills, multipliers, base stats, and newly released Aniimo.

skillChangesJson.description: JSON array of skill multiplier and cooldown adjustments

statChangesJson.description: JSON array of base stat balance changes

newAniimoJson.description: JSON array of newly released Aniimo definitions to add to catalog

syncedByUid.description: UID of user/admin who synced this patch

ModerationBan.title: ModerationBan
ModerationBan.description: Admin moderation timeout or permanent ban record issued against an unruly user or author.

targetIdentifier.description: Target user UID or normalized username

targetAuthorName.description: Display name of the timed-out or banned user

expiresAtMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds when timeout expires, or 0 for permanent ban

issuedByEmail.description: Admin email who issued the moderation action

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when action was issued

AppRemoteConfig.title: AppRemoteConfig
AppRemoteConfig.description: Over-the-air live configuration, global announcement banner, remote data reset epoch, and GitHub Release metadata.

directApkUrl.description: Direct download URL to latest GitHub release APK

liveAnnouncement.description: Global announcement banner displayed live in the app without requiring an APK update

remoteResetEpoch.description: Incrementing counter that triggers a live over-the-air clear of pre-seeded data on connected clients

updatedByEmail.description: Admin email who published the live config

/leaderboard_entries/{entryId}.description: Leaderboard speedrun entries with video links

/leaderboard_entries/{entryId}/votes/{vo.description: Per-user verification votes (Legit/Not Legit) for a leaderboard entry

/patches/{patchId}.description: Live Aniimo patch notes that auto-configure skill multipliers and new Aniimo

/moderation_bans/{banId}.description: Admin moderation timeouts and permanent bans

/app_config/{configId}.description: Live over-the-air app configuration and GitHub release update feed
